patch_description: Structural redesign replacing the exhaustive layout-enumeration + LP scoring with a seeded stochastic hill-climb over circle positions. A cheap vectorized greedy radius solver (`compute_max_radii`) acts as a pre-screen for every trial move; the exact LP (`_lp_radii`) is only invoked when the greedy sum beats the incumbent's greedy sum minus a small margin, drastically cutting LP calls. The search starts from multiple hex-lattice seeds (different row compositions and stagger patterns) and perturbs individual circle coordinates, keeping the best (centers, radii) found. This data-flow change (greedy screen → selective LP) lets the constructor explore far more configurations within the time budget, pushing sum_radii well above the previous 2.25 while retaining validity via the exact LP solution.
